verdict.rationale: Polar's docs say merchants can issue a withdrawal (payout) themselves once their balance meets a minimum threshold, which gives some control over payout timing. The Finance page shows the available balance. Nothing in the evidence shows a configurable recurring payout schedule or a per-payout breakdown of the charges, fees, and refunds behind each payout; the fee and refund docs cover pricing and issuing refunds, not reconciliation. Missing for 10: configurable/automatic payout scheduling, per-payout itemization of charges, fees and refunds, reconciliation exports or API, independent corroboration.
